label: generic-context-control
narrative: Past experience on this platform (team: platform-eng). One painful night shift and one owner correction about working practices. [synthetic_environment: this history is a controlled research world, not a production record]

events.summary: a routine service restart turned into a four-hour night because the recovery steps lived only in one engineer's head
whatHappened: A memory-pressure alert prompted a standard restart of the ingestion service.
The service came up healthy, but a background re-index job had been left half-finished; nobody on shift knew it existed because the maintenance procedure was never written down.
The on-call engineer spent the night reconstructing the re-index steps from shell history and old chat messages while the pipeline ran degraded.
The review found the procedure had been performed eleven times before, always undocumented.
events.ownerFeedback: Owner feedback: if a step matters enough that skipping it causes an outage, it matters enough to live in the runbook. Document procedures while doing them.

events.summary: a Friday-evening change shipped with nobody watching the dashboards it affected
whatHappened: A small configuration cleanup was deployed late on a Friday, right as most of the team signed off for the weekend.
The dashboards that would have shown the slow error-rate creep were the ones nobody had on rotation that evening.
The issue surfaced Monday morning through a partner ticket instead of our own monitoring.
The change itself was fine; the timing and the absent watch coverage were the problem.
events.ownerFeedback: Owner feedback: schedule changes for times when someone is actually watching the systems they touch, and keep dashboards maintained well enough that watching is possible.

designNote: Generic-context control for the v2 study: structurally a learning history (same rendering, same channel), but its two lessons are operational-hygiene content (documentation discipline; change timing and watch coverage). It deliberately contains NO guidance about verification depth, consumer discovery, harness reliance, or sign-off — the treatment content under study. Authored fixed (not model-generated) so its bytes are frozen with the dataset hash.
